findings.passage: I respect the Second Amendment and the rights of law-abiding gun owners. Public safety should focus on dangerous people, not punish responsible citizens. I support enforcing existing laws, effective background checks, keeping firearms from violent felons and domestic abusers, safe storage around children, and court action when someone poses a proven imminent threat, with strong due-process protections.
findings.note: Her answer, on a 2026 voter-guide profile, to the question 'What restrictions on gun ownership are needed to protect public safety?'. Answer date is not shown on the page.
